During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ree Shala]] established a '''base''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Jaresh/Legends|Jaresh]]. It floated fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the ground on four powerful [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, and was accessed via a hidden [[lift disk]] on the moon's surface.
